title: Your first extra 100 dollars starts with five messages

body.hook: You do not need a big idea to earn your first extra hundred dollars.

beats.narration: Pick one thing you can already do. Edit videos. Fix resumes. Clean garages. Something people pay for.
Write one sentence. I help this person do this thing for this price. Then message five people today.

scene.label: Your one sentence
scene.text: I help small shops edit their videos for $50 each.
scene.caption: Then message 5 people today

beats.narration: Most will ignore you. That is normal. You are hunting for your first yes, and your first honest feedback.

scene.label: messages sent today
scene.caption: Most won't reply. You need one.

body.cta: No guarantee it works first try, but it is the fastest way to learn what people will pay for. Not financial advice.

cta.title: DO IT TODAY
cta.tagline: Message five people before you sleep.

post.ytTitle: Your first extra $100 starts with 5 messages
post.ytDesc: A simple step you can do today: pick one skill, write one sentence, message five people. No guarantees, it is just the fastest way to learn what people will pay for.
